### South Dakota (SD) Tax Research Notes (Tax Years 2025 and 2026)

---

### 1. Individual Return Due Dates and Extensions
* **Fact:** South Dakota does not impose a personal or individual income tax. There are no individual income tax returns, filing due dates, or extension rules.
* **Applicable Tax Years:** Tax years 2025 and 2026 (unchanged).
* **Official URLs:** 
  * https://dor.sd.gov/individuals/taxes/
  * https://dor.sd.gov/businesses/taxes/sales-use-tax/

---

### 2. Corporate and Pass-Through Return Due Dates and Extensions
* **General Corporate & Pass-Through Entities:**
  * **Fact:** South Dakota does not impose a corporate income tax or pass-through entity income tax. There are no corporate or pass-through income tax returns, due dates, or extension filings.
  * **Applicable Tax Years:** Tax years 2025 and 2026 (unchanged).
  * **Official URL:** https://dor.sd.gov/businesses/taxes/

* **Financial Institutions (Bank Franchise Tax):**
  * **Fact:** Financial institutions regularly engaged in business in South Dakota are subject to the Bank Franchise Tax under SDCL Chapter 10-43. 
    * **Due Date:** Returns and payments are due within 15 days after the taxpayer's federal income tax return is due (SDCL 10-43-30).
    * **Extensions:** An extension to file not exceeding 6 months from the original due date is granted under SDCL 10-43-30.1. To qualify, the institution must submit to the Department on or before the original due date: (1) a cover letter requesting the extension, (2) a copy of the Federal Income Tax Extension Request Form, and (3) payment of the estimated tax (minimum tax is $200 per return).
  * **Applicable Tax Years:** Tax years 2025 and 2026 (unchanged).
  * **Official URLs:** 
    * https://dor.sd.gov/businesses/taxes/bank-franchise-tax/
    * https://sdlegislature.gov/Statutes/10-43-30
    * https://sdlegislature.gov/Statutes/10-43-30.1

---

### 3. Elective Pass-Through Entity Tax (PTET)
* **Fact:** Not found. South Dakota does not have an individual or corporate income tax and has no elective pass-through entity tax.
* **Applicable Tax Years:** Tax years 2025 and 2026 (unchanged).
* **Official URL:** https://dor.sd.gov/businesses/taxes/

---

### 4. Composite or Group Nonresident Returns for Pass-Through Entities
* **Fact:** Not found. Because South Dakota does not impose an individual income tax, composite or group nonresident returns do not exist.
* **Applicable Tax Years:** Tax years 2025 and 2026 (unchanged).
* **Official URL:** https://dor.sd.gov/individuals/taxes/

---

### 5. Estimated Tax Payments and Nonresident Withholding for Pass-Throughs
* **Pass-Through Entities / Nonresidents:**
  * **Fact:** Not found. Pass-through entities are not subject to estimated income tax payments or nonresident income withholding.
* **Bank Franchise Tax (Financial Institutions Only):**
  * **Fact:** A financial institution whose tax liability in the previous year exceeded $10,000 must file and pay a quarterly estimate of tax due for the current year on or before the 15th day of January, April, July, and October for calendar-year taxpayers (or the 15th day of the month following the end of the quarter for fiscal-year taxpayers) (SDCL 10-43-30).
  * **Applicable Tax Years:** Tax years 2025 and 2026 (unchanged).
  * **Official URL:** https://sdlegislature.gov/Statutes/10-43-30

---

### 6. Main Return Forms
* **Individual, Corporate, and Pass-Through Income Tax Forms:** 
  * **Fact:** Not found. No individual, general corporate, or pass-through entity income tax return forms exist.
* **Financial Institutions:** 
  * **Fact:** Financial institutions submit the Bank Franchise Tax return through the Department of Revenue's online Filing and Payment portal.
  * **Applicable Tax Years:** Tax years 2025 and 2026 (unchanged).
  * **Official URL:** https://dor.sd.gov/businesses/taxes/bank-franchise-tax/
